answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable security deposit in a shared harbor fund before it can trade. The deposit is released only after a long, fixed voyage of verified useful work attested by independent peers. If auditors catch one operator running many identities, each deposit is slashed and paid to the auditors, like a plume of smoke marking the fraud. A Sybil attacker must therefore fund every fake identity up front and risks losing all of it, while honest agents get their deposit back.
